description: Chimera NFT (formerly eblanNFT) — NFT gifts, profile customization, and sync between plugin users.
balance_spend_toggle_sub: Market purchases deduct the balance. Turn off and purchases are free — the balance stays put.
explain_main_body: Gifts, NFT profile decoration and backups live here. Long-press any row to copy a link straight to it.
explain_profile_body: Wear decorates the profile. Username, Number and rating replace the matching data for Chimera NFT users. Regular gifts can only be hidden for yourself.
explain_backup_body: Save a copy of the profile to bring gifts and decoration back later. Automatic copies are made after important changes.
explain_rating_body: Pick a level and the number of points inside its allowed range. The badge and the bar update as soon as you save.
sync_status_off: Off · data stays on this device
sync_queued_toast: Changes queued in the single writer
perf_smooth_sub: Soft animations and one shared rhythm
perf_note: The plugin only drops heavy effects under real load.
opt_dormant_sub: In a channel the channel itself writes the posts — skip resolving the author per cell
opt_unhookfling_sub: While scrolling, getUser/getChat hooks are unregistered — they come back on their own
opt_emojifreeze_sub: Custom emoji frames stand still while the list moves
diag_hooks_sub: Which hooks really load the interface
diag_order_sub: What happened during the last pinned-gift drag
hook_killswitch_sub: Bisect the cause of lag on a live device
speedups_note: Every speed-up is on by default. Turn them off one by one to find the culprit.
number_add_sub: A new number in the +888... format
about_description:
Chimera NFT {0} (formerly eblanNFT)
NFT gifts, profile customization,
and sync between plugin users.
channel_reminder_toggle: Remind me about the developer channel
channel_reminder_toggle_sub: A launch popup if you are not subscribed yet. Settings still open only after you join
channel_required_body: To use Chimera NFT, subscribe to the developer channel. Updates only — no ads.
channel_gate_body: Subscribe to the channel so the plugin can stay free. There are no ads there — only Chimera NFT updates.
channel_thanks_body: You can use the plugin now. Open settings when you are ready.
changelog_1_1_0:
Signed access decisions that cannot be forged by a proxy
Client-wide bans now cover transfers, offers, replies, listings, and purchases
Clear ban reasons are shown instead of opaque HTTP errors
Deleted profile items no longer return after restart
Gift edits preserve owner-configured value, resale, visibility, and TON settings
changelog_1_0_0:
A new release of Chimera NFT, formerly eblanNFT
Faster profiles, chats, and lists
Haptics only for important completed actions
Fresh sync and client-wide multi-account bans
Regular gifts can be hidden from everyone else — you still see them
A worn gift shows its model and number
Supporter badge
Another user's pinned channel is visible
Badges and the worn gift now show in the chat header and the dialog list too
Balance section: ⭐️ and gram with a transaction history
Tap a transaction for details, long-press to delete your own
The balance survives a restart and an update
Local Premium
Data is no longer lost after a restart
Backups save themselves, and restoring is built in
.profile import: you choose what to apply, and the file opens straight from a chat
The plugin lowers its own load — fewer stutters in chats and profiles
A help section with tips and videos
Long-press a setting to get a link to it
changelog_1_7_0:
The pinned gift order stays where you dragged it
A collectible username can replace the real one
Rating: a sheet that previews the badge for every level
Price and purchase date in one sheet
changelog_1_6_0: Collectible username cards are drawn right on the device
data_folder_hint: Backups live in {0} — visible in a file manager and shareable into a chat.
data_auto_body: The plugin saves the state after every important change and keeps a short history. Those copies are picked up automatically if the main file gets damaged.
data_reset_confirm: Gifts, username, number, rating, balances with their history, collections, the pinned channel and local Premium all go — on this device and on the server. The profile ends up the way it was right after install, ready to be built again. A backup is the only way back.
data_reset_done: All data deleted — the profile can be built again
section_gifts_sub: Library, the active gift and wear
section_usernames_sub: The list, the selected username and the template
section_number_sub: The list, the selected number and the template
section_rating_sub: Points, level and the next goal
backups_empty_hint: No backups yet. Create the first one — it is saved as a .profile file you can send into a chat or move to another device.
backup_delete_confirm: {0} will be deleted for good. It is the only way back to that state.
create_subtitle: Tick what goes into the file. Each row shows what it holds right now.
create_conflict_renamed: A backup with that name existed — saved as {0}
create_no_file_utils: Writing files is unavailable in this client
restore_no_changes: The backup matches the current data — nothing to apply.
profile_err_no_payload: The file carries no profile data
profile_err_bad_payload: The file is damaged and cannot be read
profile_err_not_ours: This backup belongs to another plugin
profile_err_too_new: The backup comes from a newer version — update the plugin
profile_err_no_sections: The backup has no supported data
